filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Wed Nov 4 evening – Fri Nov 6 morning PT

market_briefing.lede: Platform vendors pushed agent build tooling and enterprise control planes on Nov 5: Salesforce put Builder Central and Quick Pages into beta so admins and end users can stand up apps, agents, and governed views in plain language, Anthropic made Claude Enterprise inference hooks generally available for prompt and tool-call policy checks, and OpenAI productized its cyber research stack as GPT-6 Cyber for approved Daybreak Red defenders.

bullets.text: Nov 5: Salesforce launched Builder Central (beta), a no-code hub that builds and deploys apps and agents from plain language against existing org metadata, permissions, Lifecycle Center pipelines, and ephemeral preview orgs; admins enable via Access Builder Central permission + Metadata Experts MCP Server.

Nov 5: Anthropic shipped a Claude Enterprise security center (beta) and made inference hooks GA — prompt hooks and pre-tool-call hooks that send traffic to customer DLP/security tools before Claude responds or runs a tool — plus centralized parent-org management and Desktop shadow-IT controls.

Nov 5: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber (Preparedness: Critical), citing 48.5% on ExploitGym (vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber), 81 novel high-severity Firefox vulns with Mozilla patches landing, and the same 948 Linux LPEs disclosed Nov 4; initial API/Codex access is limited to approved Daybreak Red customers.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber for aligned cybersecurity agents
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 5: specialized model for authorized vuln discovery/exploit validation; Critical under Preparedness Framework; 51% relative ExploitGym gain vs GPT-5.6 Cyber; powers Daybreak Red; Cisco, Calif, CodeRabbit, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Perplexity among named users; Cyber at the Frontier livestream Nov 12.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic expands Claude Enterprise security controls; inference hooks GA
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 5: security center (beta) compares org settings to Anthropic recommendations; prompt + pre-tool-call inference hooks GA for customer-hosted policy checks; centralized management console (beta) at admin.claude.com; Admin API member sign-out, self-serve IP allowlist, Desktop personal-account block, and EDR-in-Cowork VM (beta) also shipped.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google Antigravity confirms Remote Agents cloud rollout
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 5 evening PT / Nov 6 media: @antigravity said Remote Agents are rolling out this week — tasks run in independent cloud VMs, controllable from phone at antigravity.google.com/remote. Changelog dates v2.29 (Voice Mode + Remote Agents for Google AI Pro/Ultra) Nov 3; company amplification is Nov 5–6.

what_changed.title: Salesforce Builder Central enters beta
what_changed.body: NEW. Nov 5 Admins blog: no-code plain-language builder for apps, data models, flows, and agents that inherits org security/permissions; complements Setup with Agentforce (direct admin edits) and existing Flow/Lightning/Agentforce Builders; deploys via Lifecycle Center; Interactive Metadata Visualizations + ephemeral Preview Orgs for safe review. Enable: Access Builder Central permission, beta feature, Metadata Experts MCP Server (prefer Developer/Developer Pro sandbox).

what_changed.title: Salesforce Quick Pages (Beta) lets users build governed single-page apps
what_changed.body: NEW. Nov 5 Salesforce blog: natural-language Quick Pages with charts, tables, tabs, and actions on live CRM data; creation does not change org metadata; Create/View Quick Pages (Beta) permission sets; Headless Toolkit underneath; beta pages are read-only (no record writes yet); AI chat free in beta, metered at GA. Roadmap tease: record writes, Apex/Connect REST, Data 360, Claude integration.

what_changed.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 5 productization of the cyber stack behind the Nov 4 Linux LPE research; Daybreak Blue (Astra) vs Daybreak Red (Cyber) split; Critical cyber classification; Firefox 81 novel high-severity findings with Mozilla fixes landing.

what_changed.title: Anthropic Claude Enterprise security wave
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 5: security center + inference hooks GA + centralized parent-org management + Desktop/EDR controls aimed at enterprise GTM buyers running Claude alongside CRM/agent stacks.

what_changed.title: Salesloft newsroom still on Oct 27 after Behind Every Win
what_changed.body: Negative confirm (unchanged). As of Nov 6 morning, newsroom latest remains Oct 27 Agentic Playbook / Ask Salesloft / meeting-prep early access — no GA date or pricing post after the Nov 4 summit.

quiet_note: No new launch/funding/M&A/pricing from Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, or Monaco in the Nov 4 evening–Nov 6 morning window beyond items already led Nov 4–5. Salesforce's Nov 5 APAC Coworker press (185k users / $50/user/mo / Teams+mobile+desktop) is the regional reissue of the Nov 4 Coworker story already on Today — not a new launch. Agent Optimizer X promo Nov 5 packages October GA, not a fresh ship. Monaco (Sam Blond) promoted a Nov 18 Vertical Agent Meetup in SF. Outreach published a Nov 5 coaching-models thought-leadership blog (no product/pricing). Nooks/Dan Lee amplified the Nov 4 Node/$500M story via MTS interview follow-ons. Agent Evals / API Evals still listed "Beta in November 2026" on the Oct 27 Agent Fabric post with no separate start notice found Nov 5–6.

watch.title: Agent Evals November beta start; Builder Central / Quick Pages GA path; Salesloft Agentic Playbook GA or pricing
watch.body: Oct 27 Agent Fabric post still lists Agent Evals and API Evals as "Beta in November 2026" (GA Jan 2027) with no separate start notice Nov 5–6. Builder Central and Quick Pages just entered beta — watch permissioning, Preview Org limits, and GA/metering. Salesloft newsroom remains on Oct 27 early access after the Nov 4 summit.

interpretation.fact: Nov 5 Salesforce put Builder Central and Quick Pages into beta (plain-language app/agent build + governed user pages). Same day Anthropic GA'd Claude Enterprise inference hooks and shipped a security center; OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber. Nov 5–6 Google Antigravity amplified Remote Agents cloud rollout (v2.29 changelog Nov 3). Salesloft newsroom still Oct 27. No new Gong/Clay/Nooks/Outreach/Monaco launch/funding/M&A/pricing. Nov 5 Coworker APAC press restates Nov 4 Coworker package.
interpretation.note: Interpretation: After Coworker packaging on Nov 4, Salesforce's next move is lowering the build surface — admins and business users creating agents/views in-product — while model vendors race on runtime governance (hooks, evals) and specialized defender SKUs. Watchlist peers are not matching that build+govern cadence this week; Salesloft leaving Agentic Playbook in early access through a named summit still reads as staged pricing/GA, not a slip-live.
